purpose: Source-only diagnostic checklist prepared before this article is acquired; grouped meanings and qualifications, not future-answer labels.

source.title: Taylor Swift is Time’s Person of the Year
source.author: Chelsea Ritschel

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift
assertions.assertion: named Time’s 2023 Person of the Year; announced Wednesday December 6

assertions.subject: Time Person of the Year selection
assertions.assertion: editorial assessment of the individual shaping headlines over previous 12 months, for better or worse

assertions.subject: Other contenders
assertions.assertion: Xi Jinping, King Charles III, live-action Barbie movie, Vladimir Putin; contenders, not joint winners

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift
assertions.assertion: age 33 at reporting time; magazine described her combination of art and commerce as historically powerful

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift Time interview
assertions.assertion: reported feeling especially proud, happy, creatively fulfilled and free; attributed self-assessment

assertions.subject: Eras Tour
assertions.assertion: reported dominant 2023 ticket sales, record-breaking; estimated gross over 1.4 billion dollars, not an exact realized amount

assertions.subject: Eras Tour concert film
assertions.assertion: global box office surpassed 250 million dollars since October opening weekend

assertions.subject: Swift-Kelce relationship
assertions.assertion: article attributes 400-percent spike in NFL jersey sales to it; no narrower jersey population supplied

assertions.subject: Travis Kelce
assertions.assertion: Kansas City Chiefs tight end

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift NFL attendance
assertions.assertion: first appearance September; occasional appearances at Kelce games

assertions.subject: Some NFL fans
assertions.assertion: criticized her attendance as distracting from games; attributed opinion, not universal fan belief

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift
assertions.assertion: said she attended to support Travis and was unaware of whether broadcasts showed her too much

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift
assertions.assertion: expressed newly discovered enjoyment of football

assertions.subject: Swift-Kelce romance
assertions.assertion: Swift said it began after Kelce’s podcast shoutout about attempting to give her his phone number after an Eras Tour show

assertions.subject: Swift and Kelce
assertions.assertion: began spending time together immediately afterward and were already a couple by first September Chiefs-game appearance

assertions.subject: First Chiefs-game appearance
assertions.assertion: not their first date according to Swift; no exact first-date day supplied

assertions.subject: Joe Alwyn
assertions.assertion: British actor; associated with Conversations with Friends

assertions.subject: Swift-Alwyn breakup
assertions.assertion: revealed in April after six years of dating; announcement date not exact separation date

assertions.subject: Joe Alwyn privacy
assertions.assertion: previously said discussing relationship fed a strange aspect of culture; attributed reason

assertions.subject: Swift-Kelce public relationship
assertions.assertion: Swift described showing up for each other and mutual pride, contrasting with effort to conceal a relationship

assertions.subject: Eras Tour concert format
assertions.assertion: over 180 minutes, more than 40 songs from at least 9 albums, 16 costume changes per concert

assertions.subject: Swift tour preparation
assertions.assertion: daily treadmill exercise while singing entire set list aloud

assertions.subject: Swift training pace
assertions.assertion: ran fast for fast songs; jogged or walked fast for slow songs

assertions.subject: Swift tour preparation
assertions.assertion: stopped drinking; three months of dance training; said dancing was not her strong suit

assertions.subject: Swift recovery
assertions.assertion: said she took a day to rest after a run of shows before next performance; largely stayed in bed except getting food

assertions.subject: Rio de Janeiro Eras Tour
assertions.assertion: heat wave led to postponement of second night in Rio, Brazil

assertions.subject: Ana Clara Benevides
assertions.assertion: fan, age 23; article reports death from cardiac arrest during Swift’s first performance in Brazil

assertions.subject: Postponement sequence
assertions.assertion: decision followed the fan’s death; do not replace the explicitly stated heat-wave reason with inferred sole causation

assertions.subject: Swift performance commitment
assertions.assertion: said she intends to perform despite illness, injury, heartbreak, discomfort or stress unless force majeure; attributed commitment, not proof of each condition occurring

assertions.subject: Scooter Braun
assertions.assertion: acquired Big Machine Records in 2019, thereby gaining rights to masters of Swift’s first six studio albums

assertions.subject: Big Machine Records
assertions.assertion: Swift’s longtime label at time described; distinguish label acquisition from recording rights

assertions.subject: Scooter Braun master sale
assertions.assertion: sold masters to an unnamed investment fund in November 2020; deal believed over 300 million dollars

assertions.subject: Swift rerecorded albums
assertions.assertion: four Taylor’s Version releases by article time; not all six original masters

assertions.subject: Fearless (Taylor’s Version)
assertions.assertion: released April 2021

assertions.subject: Red (Taylor’s Version)
assertions.assertion: released November 2021

assertions.subject: Speak Now (Taylor’s Version)
assertions.assertion: released July 2023

assertions.subject: 1989 (Taylor’s Version)
assertions.assertion: released October 2023

assertions.subject: Swift success explanation
assertions.assertion: she described cancellation and losing control of work as two painful catalysts; her interpretation, not independently proved causal effect

assertions.subject: Taylor Swift
assertions.assertion: Grammy winner; no award count supplied

assertions.subject: Tree Paine
assertions.assertion: Swift’s publicist; publicly denied rumors involving Swift and Alwyn; rumor contents unspecified

assertions.subject: Swift public attention
assertions.assertion: said paparazzi and attention would not stop her living life or dining with friends

assertions.subject: Swift retrospective
assertions.assertion: regretted years spent isolating at home and described herself as more trusting than six years earlier; attributed self-assessment

negative_checks: Exclude repeated newsletter controls and template errors as domain events.
Preserve greater-than, minimum, estimated and believed bounds; do not convert them to exact totals.
Do not invent investment-fund name, first-date day, breakup day, unspecified rumor contents or master-sale currency beyond source notation.
Preserve attribution for self-reports, editorial selection and causal claims; no independent medical or historical verification is implied.
